name: Packed Voxel Vertex Unpacking & Rendering
definition: Unpacks a single 32-bit integer per vertex into spatial coordinates, material ID, face ID, ambient occlusion ID, and flip ID to render voxel geometry efficiently.
summary: Packed Voxel Vertex Unpacking & Rendering decodes a single 32-bit integer per vertex to reconstruct spatial coordinates and attributes, distinguishing itself by eliminating additional vertex buffer attributes for efficient GPU rendering.
